verdict.rationale: First-party docs list NPM packages for all modules and tree-shakable ES6 modules. A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core is published on npm (v9.26.1, Apache-2.0, ~234k weekly downloads), so it installs, imports and bundles like any dependency. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party bundler or tree-shaking guidance beyond one-line summaries, and independent hands-on confirmation that tree-shaking actually reduces bundle size.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency

citations.quote: Modular design with tree-shakable ES6 modules
Framework packages, NPM support, ES6 modules
`npm view @babylonjs/core version` → 9.26.1 (Apache-2.0, 234,040 weekly downloads via the public npm API)
